concepts.title: International Trade and Balance of Trade

questions.q: Calculate the balance of trade given exports and imports. Use the method 'International Trade and Balance of Trade'. Work with: export_value = 80000, import_value = 8000. Carry the chain through step by step and give the final value of balance_of_trade.
questions.a: 72000 units

questions.q: Explain in your own words what 'International Trade and Balance of Trade' refers to.
questions.a: International trade involves cross-border goods movement, where balance of trade equals total export value minus import value.

questions.q: State the single key point to remember about 'International Trade and Balance of Trade'.
questions.a: A trade surplus occurs when export value exceeds import value, creating a favourable trade balance.

questions.q: Write the standard relation used for 'International Trade and Balance of Trade', in plain ASCII form.
questions.a: balance_of_trade = export_value - import_value
